description: This is a React component source file implementing a mind map visualization for an 'Explore' feature. It defines types for nodes, edges, and viewport, includes functions for layout computation and label wrapping, and renders an interactive SVG-based mind map with zoom and pan controls.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Restricts a number within specified min and max bounds.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps a text label into multiple lines based on maximum characters per line and line count, with ellipsis if overflowing.

methods.name: computeRadialLayout
methods.description: Calculates positions for nodes arranged in a radial layout, with the 'current' node at the center.
